candidates.title: Keep feedback conditions comparable within an RL rollout group
candidates.rule: For group-relative agent RL, compare consistent enrichment across rollouts of the same state with independently randomized feedback variants before introducing within-group diversity.
candidates.passage: providing diverse feedback within a single group leads to severe instability
candidates.finding: With Qwen3-4B on SciWorld over 200 GRPO steps, consistent feedback shows steadier validation improvement than within-group stochastic variants. The proposed advantage-estimation mechanism is an explanation, not independently isolated.
candidates.conditions: Enrichment is injected during training and standard environments are used for validation. Hold feedback variants comparable for the group-relative comparison.
candidates.limitations: One focused consistency experiment; the same enrichment approach yields no positive rewards on AppWorld with Qwen3-4B or 8B. Stage definitions are manual and sensitivity underexplored. This is not a rule against diversity across different groups.
candidates.validation_test: At fixed rollout budget compare group-consistent and within-group-random enrichment, measuring variance, reward collapse and final performance without enrichment on held-out tasks.

review_scope: Selected abstract, introduction, methods or main-result sections; not a comprehensive paper or appendix review.
